methodology: Separate fresh processes/projects avoid competing .sql loaders; deterministic shuffled candidate order per trial. Cold startup is process spawn to first validated query report, including loader imports/analysis but excluding fixture creation; first-call latency separately excludes loader/import/setup. Warm samples exclude imports/setup/warmup/assertions. p50/p95 must be computed from batch-average raw samples, not individual request-tail latency. One SQLite connection, so concurrency means queued logical calls, not parallel SQLite I/O. All candidates return equivalent rows; JSON text is parsed within timed operations where the driver/frontend does not decode it. Reylo freshness behavior is unchanged. Heap-used delta is retained-heap noise, not allocated bytes; allocation/CPU attribution comes from separate V8 profiles, whose timings are not comparable to ordinary runs.
